channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 release candidate
item.description: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 runs a self-contained AI model on device CPUs to detect unstructured secrets in air-gapped networks without GPUs or external connectivity, and makes Dependabot wait three days after a package version's release before opening update PRs. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
item.description: OpenAI’s layered defenses against adversarial distillation, spanning model training, safeguards, detection and enforcement, cut internal red-team average attack success from 54.0% to 0.2% for GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol’s protected reasoning. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Codex CLI 0.171.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.171.0 arrives with a complete changelog spanning rust-v0.170.0 to rust-v0.171.0, alongside the latest ChatGPT and Codex updates, so you can trace what changed between the two releases. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
item.description: Harness adapters, illustrated with Qwen3.8-27B on pi harness’s Terminal-Bench 2.1, lift pass@1 from 39% to 55% while cutting average tokens from 2.9K to 1.5K, with RL training recipes reusable across Pi, OpenCode and Hermes Agent. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Pin your favorite repositories to your dashboard
item.description: GitHub's new Favorite repositories section lets you choose which repositories appear on the Dashboard through a search picker, pinning up to 25 and syncing them with GitHub Mobile's pinned repositories. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Testing prerelease GPT-6 Astra on financial research in August–September 2026, Hebbia found its citations covered needed source types 13.6 percentage points more often than the best alternative model, with 99.5% of excerpts relevant and 97.9% of applicable presentation requirements met. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
item.description: Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts looped transformer with about 26B physical parameters but only 3B active per token, looping 12 of 24 layers three times for 48 equivalent layer visits, 1M-token context, and local deployment. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: 133 new registrations in two months, with 1,245 generative AI services now on record
item.description: 133 new generative AI services completed filing in September–October 2026, including 3 mobile on-device and 1 anthropomorphic interaction, while 224 applications registered, bringing cumulative filings to 1,245 and registrations to 955 as of October 31, per China’s Cyberspace Administration. (AIbase)

item.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
item.description: MedChemBench tests AI on 761 molecular structures from 117 papers and patents across 99 questions, where GPT‑6.2 Astra scores 84.5% but compound selection and property prediction remain harder. (OpenAI News)

item.title: GitHub Desktop now supports multiple accounts per host
item.description: GitHub Desktop 3.7.0 adds multi-account sign-in on a single host across GitHub.com and GHE.com, automatically migrating existing repositories to the account already in use and adding an account switcher. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: From ask-once-and-leave to picking up the last chat: Google Search adds an AI history sidebar
item.description: Google Search now offers a collapsible AI Mode sidebar on the desktop homepage that lets users quickly return to recent searches, and Robby Stein says testing shows it helps them pick up earlier conversations before a global rollout. (AIbase)

item.title: Improvements on the pull request overview in public preview
item.description: Since the November 5, 2026 public preview, the pull request Overview page now shows clearer merge status and next steps plus updated handling for failed optional checks, with a Try the Overview page button for switching to the classic view. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Ant's inclusionAI open-sources LingSante-Pulse-1.0, a physiological signal encoder with MIT-licensed representation capabilities
item.description: Ant inclusionAI released LingSante-Pulse-1.0 on Hugging Face under the MIT license, a physiological signal encoder that outputs pure representations without downstream prediction heads, pairs with the lingsante_pulse code package, and processes multi-dimensional input at 128Hz. (AIbase)

item.title: Before Opening Up Its 70B Weights, Tencent Puts Hy4 Through a "Safety Checkup
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy4 weights on November 20 across GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode, letting developers download and deploy them after a safety review preceding the 70B open release. (AIbase)

item.title: AI short dramas exit their wild-growth phase: WeChat to require full AI-generation process proof videos starting December
item.description: WeChat's Short Drama Content Center announced on November 20 that from December 1, single episodes must run at least one minute instead of 45 seconds, and any drama containing AI-generated content must submit a full-process proof video covering asset lists, episodes and prompts. (AIbase)

item.title: AI Gateway — Manage your company's AI from one place
item.description: Opening the AI Gateway page titled "Manage your company's AI from one place" returns only a CAPTCHA security check, with no product details, setup steps or features for centralized AI management. (Product Hunt)

item.title: ChatGPT's mobile app gets a major interface overhaul, as Dots expands testing and integrates with health data
item.description: On November 20, OpenAI began rolling out a redesigned ChatGPT mobile interface to ChatGPT Pro and some Plus users, giving Dots its own bottom tab and letting people pin Codex, Projects and Images. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic Shares Tank After Huge IPO As the Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gains
item.description: Anthropic Shares Tank After Huge IPO As the Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gains (Slashdot)

item.title: Google employees call on the company not to punish schools reluctant to adopt AI
item.description: Google employees call on the company not to punish schools reluctant to adopt AI (www.motherjones.com)

item.title: From a single-chat entry point to multi-module coordination, ChatGPT's mobile redesign accelerates the rollout of proactive AI services
item.description: On November 20, 2026, OpenAI began rolling out a ChatGPT mobile redesign that makes Dots a standalone bottom tab and lets modules such as Codex be pinned to the bottom bar, targeting roughly 1.2 billion weekly active users. (AIbase)
